First Drops of the Storm: Oracle 21,000, Amazon 30,000, Block 4,000, Microsoft Buyouts for 60,000. AI Is Now the No. 1 Reason Given for Layoffs in America.

Meatbag: Oracle cut 21,000 jobs this year: “the adoption and deployment of AI technologies.” Amazon, 30,000 since last fall; its CEO said you'd mean “fewer people doing some of the jobs.” Block cut 4,000, nearly half its staff, citing “intelligence tools” and “smaller and flatter teams.” Microsoft just offered exit packages to 60,000, a quarter of the company. And those are the ones who say your name. Comcast's 912 came with “a more agile company.”

The whole exchange at legacymammals.com — link in bio.
